name: Novu
summary: Open-source notification infrastructure: one API for in-app inbox, email, SMS, push and chat, plus channels for AI agents.
description: Open-source communication layer for products and agents: one API and a unified conversation model across Inbox/In-App, Email, SMS, Push, Chat, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp. Includes a workflow engine with branching and digests, a no-code email editor, an embeddable real-time React inbox and preferences component, and an Agent Communication Infrastructure (ACI) with bidirectional messaging for existing agents.
contains: 20 email providers, 37 SMS, 8 push and 13 chat providers supported
embeddable real-time inbox and preferences components (React; React Native, Vue, Angular coming soon)
workflow engine: branching, conditions and digest batching
ACI: bidirectional agent messaging on Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp and email
open-core: MIT core, enterprise folder under a commercial license
